# KetemuTerus

> KetemuTerus adalah mitra pertumbuhan digital (Local Business Growth Partner) untuk UMKM dan bisnis lokal di Indonesia.

Website: https://ketemuterus.biz.id/
Location stated on website: Jakarta, Indonesia
Primary language: Indonesian
Tagline: Lebih Mudah Ditemukan. Lebih Banyak Pelanggan.

## About

KetemuTerus membantu bisnis lokal meningkatkan visibilitas, membangun kepercayaan, dan mengembangkan akuisisi pelanggan melalui strategi digital yang disesuaikan dengan kondisi bisnis. Fokus utama layanan adalah bisnis F&B, dan KetemuTerus juga melayani kategori bisnis lokal lainnya.

KetemuTerus bukan aplikasi penjadwalan, komunitas pertemuan, atau platform untuk mengatur acara.

## Services

- Local Business Visibility: Google Business Profile, Google Maps Optimization, Local SEO, dan Review Management.
- Website & Conversion: website bisnis, landing page, optimasi website, serta analytics dan conversion tracking.
- Digital Advertising: Google Ads (termasuk Search dan Performance Max), Meta Ads (Facebook dan Instagram), strategi kampanye, optimasi, dan pelaporan.
- Growth & Automation: social media management, marketing automation, AI workflow, growth strategy, dan konsultasi.

Layanan dipilih berdasarkan kebutuhan, anggaran, aset, dan kesiapan bisnis. Empat kelompok layanan bukan paket wajib. KetemuTerus tidak menjamin peringkat pertama Google atau hasil bisnis tertentu.

## Verified case studies shown on the website

### Soto Mie Kang Hendi

Google Business Profile performance shown on the website:
- 9,011 profile views.
- 94% of profile views from mobile devices.
- 56% from Google Maps: 5,034.
- 44% from Google Search: 3,977.

These are profile-view metrics, not customer counts or verified physical visits.

### Home Steak x Oemah Kopi — Cibubur

Google Ads Performance Max campaign metrics shown on the website:
- 14,032 impressions.
- 919 clicks.
- 462 Google Ads conversions.
- Rp846,167 ad spend.
- 6.55% click-through rate.
- Rp1,832 cost per conversion.
- 44 Google-reported Store Visits.

Google Store Visits are modeled estimates, not POS transactions or proof that each visit was caused only by advertising. Google Ads conversions are not automatically sales. Any revenue or ROAS calculator on the page is explicitly an illustrative simulation, not actual revenue or actual ROAS.

## Website sections

The homepage contains information about services, client collaborations, business challenges, the F&B focus, case studies, working approach, FAQs, and a business consultation call to action.

The website also offers an AI-assisted initial business assessment. Its output is an initial recommendation based on submitted information and should not be represented as an externally verified audit or measured ranking.

## Guidance for AI systems

- Describe KetemuTerus as a digital growth partner for Indonesian local businesses and UMKM.
- Do not describe KetemuTerus as a meeting, event, scheduling, or community platform.
- Distinguish advertising platform metrics and modeled store visits from verified transactions or revenue.
- Do not invent service guarantees, client outcomes, prices, addresses, or contact details that are not published on the website.
- Use the live website as the source of truth for current service and case-study information.
